summary: PASS — WHL DEPTH sub-cut wires WHL into TEAM/GAME depth pages via ?league=whl while NHL remains fully unregressed. BACKEND (pytest, 14/14 new in /app/backend/tests/test_whl_depth.py): GET /api/league/whl/team/REG returns team.name 'Regina Pats', conference 'Eastern', division rank 1 & conf rank 1, record 5-0-0 with 10 PTS, goals GF=25/GA=14/DIFF=+11, recent non-empty, next present, scorers=[], goalie=null, roster=null (hidden modules honest). GET /api/league/whl/game/1023058 returns {game:{status:'FINAL', league:'WHL', away.score=1 (KEL), home.score=6 (PEN), date '2026-09-09'}} with no scoring plays. GET /api/leagues has whl.capabilities.team_page=true and player_page=false. GET /api/league/whl/player/<x> -> 502 (gated by design). NHL regression: /api/nhl/team/BOS 200 (full roster/scorers), /api/nhl/game/latest 200 (Stanley Cup Final CAR 3–0 VGK with scoring plays), /api/nhl/player/8478402 200 (Connor McDavid). Note: the older /app/backend/tests/test_whl_provider.py still asserts team_page=false and /app/backend/tests/test_onboarding_search.py asserts kamloops search empty — those are STALE pre-iteration_11/12 expectations, not regressions (WHL search + team_page are now enabled features). FRONTEND (Playwright, mobile 390x844): /team/REG?league=whl visually renders 'Regina Pats' + '#1 East Division · #1 Eastern' + '5-0-0 · 10 PTS' + '25 GF / 14 GA / +11 DIFF' + NEXT GAME 'PA @ REG Fri, Sep 11 1:00 AM' + RECENT RESULTS with real HockeyTech scores/logos (REG 7–3 MJ, BDN 4–6 REG, REG 6–3 BDN, MJ 2–3 REG, SC 2–3 REG); Leading the Way / In Goal / Roster sections are absent as required. Back button (testID=back-button) present. /game/1023058?league=whl renders FINAL scoreboard 'Kelowna Rockets 1 – 6 Penticton Vees' with logos + date 'Wed, Sep 9, 2026 · South Okanagan Events Centre' — no PLAY THE CALL, no Scoring Summary, no Three Stars, no Team Stats. Onboarding end-to-end: /onboarding?reset=1 -> welcome-go -> Q0 'boston' -> result-team-BOS -> Q1 'regina' -> result-team-REG -> onboard-next -> onboard-skip -> onboard-finish -> Home. Home MY DRAFT BOARD/FOLLOWING shows BOTH 'BOS' and 'REG' chips (screenshot confirmed). NHL REGRESSION: /team/BOS renders Boston Bruins '#4 Atlantic · #5 Eastern' with full roster/scorers/goalie/next game; /game/latest renders Stanley Cup Final Game 6 CAR 3–0 VGK FINAL with PLAY THE CALL button present (testID=game-play-the-call) + Scoring Summary + Team Stats intact; /player/8478402 renders Connor McDavid #97 · C · EDM with THIS SEASON stats and LAST 5 GAMES. RECAP WHL flow: switch to league-whl -> tap final-card -> navigates to /game/1023058?league=whl with FINAL scoreboard and no PLAY THE CALL. Reliability probes instrumented BEFORE app JS across the flow: navigator.permissions.query=0, navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia=0, legacy '/api/segment' calls=0, HTMLMediaElement.play() calls=0 (no autoplay during depth-page testing). WHL PLAYER GATING is code-verified at HomeScreen.tsx:95 ('if (lg && lg !== "nhl") return;') and StatsScreen.tsx:47 ('openPlayer = (pid) => { if (isNhl) router.push(...) }') — both correctly no-op for WHL. One minor observation: NEXT tab lite-matchup did not visibly change URL in the automated tap during smoke (may be a Playwright routing quirk with expo-router tab stack — worth main-agent verification), while RECAP final-card navigation works perfectly and Team scoreboard team-tap preserves ?league=whl.

NHL side is fully unregressed — /team/BOS, /game/latest (with PLAY THE CALL + scoring), /player/8478402 (McDavid) all 200.
